node.title: Re: Perl launching process
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So the question is when is it appropriate to use each system, backtick, or other modules? Is there best practice?

See my take on pretty much that exact question here: [id://1180578].

Basically, I would almost always recommend using a module over system and especially backticks, for the reasons I describe there. I usually recommend [mod://IPC::System::Simple]'s systemx and capturex, or if you want control over STDIN and STDERR as well, [mod://IPC::Run3].
